correctness.rationale: The degree-sum activation identity is exact. The first successful update with four starting edges forces the complete two-center cover, yielding a finite case split whose P5 and 2P3 survivors have verified explicit rounds. Labelled path counts and elementary replacement reconnection counts give closed formulas. Connectedness is proved with prefix reversals, support changes, and a direct 2P3-to-P5 edge swap. Separate implementations reproduce all four-edge starters for n=5..10 and exchange networks for n=5..8.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of optimizers for four-neighbour bootstrap on triangular graphs, beyond the already known optimum cardinality. The first two path forests yield a sharply testable finite-motif dichotomy, exact all-order multiplicities and propagation times, and a connected nonregular configuration-exchange graph; these are useful structural and temporal benchmarks rather than a routine numeric increment.
